unit: U1 picture (FORAGE): camera team, quiet observational cut
changed_fields: P-* dates: Vachon Radford photos are 1940 Dec. (plan said 1941). Mydans stairwells are 1935 Sept., Resettlement Administration.

P-STAIR-EMPTY-2 (2017714055) is NOT seen from above: both 2017714055 and 2017714056 look UP the stairwell from below, and are near-identical neighbouring negatives (slight shift). camera_viewpoint for both = from below.
P-STAIR-MAN 2017811447 is the untitled frame; 2017811448 is the titled one ("Powder plant employee going upstairs"). Roles as in plan: 447 profile (main), 448 gaze (branch).
P-BUNK subject looks toward the lens (eyes open). Viewpoint is outside him (foot of bunk); the gaze is recorded, as with stair-gaze.
P-ROOM crop keeps one empty bed + part of chair, not two beds.
P-TEL = Russell Lee 2017735081 (1936, farm home near Dickens, Iowa), not a boardinghouse. Bubley reserve crop also prepared.
P-WAKE-2 found: 2017811449 (same bunk, same man, through the doorway); alternate 2017811427.
STAIR cuts are frame-quantised at 24 fps: empty1 frames 0-33, man 34-81 (t=1.4167-3.4167), empty2 82-143. E4 lands at p 13.4167, E6 at p 25.4167 (+0.0167 s vs plan).
rules_followed: User-Agent oulipo-film-research/1.0; downloads only from www.loc.gov and tile.loc.gov (Commons API attempted, rate-limited); decoded only with PIL (python3 -I) and ffmpeg; no filters, grain, vignette or tint; crops remove film rebate (edge numbers, sprocket notches) only; Lanczos resize; black box at true aspect. Downloads 4.0 MB (<=40 MB). No commit.

performer.label: the lodger
performer.evidence: LoC links 2017811447<->2017811448 (same stair man, visually same: cap, knit pullover) and 2017811426<->2017811427/2017811449 (same bunk man). No LoC link between the bunk man (W.W. McDaniel) and the stair man (unnamed "powder plant employee"). Both wear a similar light knit pullover, but the stair man wears a cap and the faces cannot be matched with confidence. Identity is montage-constructed; the voice never names him.
